Human: What is inflation and is it bad?

Assistant: Inflation is the speed at which prices are increasing.  Inflation is a normal economic phenomenon. It’s normal to have it to some extent in an economy, and it happens as a result of other factors (such as population growth and productivity growth). However, inflation can sometimes become very high and cause a lot of problems, for example when it’s caused by too much money being pumped into the economy from a central bank, as it has been in the past and is currently.  We don’t have to worry about it too much now, but we can expect to see inflation at higher rates in the future.

Human: What is a bad rate of inflation?

Assistant: High inflation is normally not a big problem, but if the rate of inflation gets very high, it can cause some serious problems.  For example, if your salary is fixed (like the cost of a cell phone plan) and prices are rising, you will end up losing buying power and it can make it difficult for people to maintain their standard of living.  Also, businesses can’t easily make long-term plans if the prices of goods they need are increasing, so it can hurt their ability to plan and plan ahead.  I wouldn’t say inflation is “bad”, but if it’s too high it can create problems for people.

Human: what causes the rate of inflation to get very high?

Assistant: Many factors affect the rate of inflation in an economy.  For example, if there’s too much money being pumped into the economy by the central bank (also called “printing money” or “printing new money”), this tends to increase inflation.  Also, if the economy is growing very fast, this also tends to increase inflation.  If the economy is running short of goods, or if people want to spend more money than they have, this can also increase the rate of inflation.

Human: What can we do to slow the rate of inflation?

Assistant: We have to wait for the economy to recover and for inflation to return to normal levels.  In the meantime, we can just be aware of the risks and watch out for them. But right now inflation is at a normal level and not likely to get any higher.
